svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Capped with not less than 50 mm of
Roof framing on a wood plate not less
Roof framing on a wood plate, (2)

svg.text: loadbearing walls of hollow masonry units
supporting roof or floor framing members are
capped with not less than 50 mm (1 15/16″) of
solid masonry or have the top course filled
The capping may be omitted where the roof
framing is supported on a wood plate not less
Drawn: walls cut through, framing cut back, cap and filled cores tinted pink. Anchorage (Subsection 9.20.11.) not shown.
